jobs.occupation: Experienced Data Platform Engineer - Data Foundation - Aarhus or Gdansk
jobs.description:
Viby J, Denmark, 8260

Gdansk, Poland, 80-244

Category: Information Technology

Permanent

Do you want to help shape and evolve the foundation that powers data-driven decision-making across Arla?

In Data Foundation, we are responsible for delivering and evolving the core Azure Databricks data platform and infrastructure that enables analytics, reporting and AI solutions across Arla. As an Experienced Data Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction of the team, mentoring colleagues and ensuring we continue to deliver a modern, enterprise-grade platform that supports the needs of the business, says Senior Manager, Head of IT Product, Thomas Morthorst Overgaard.

How you will make an impact

As an Experienced Data Platform Engineer, you will join an international team responsible for developing and maintaining Arla’s Data Foundation Platform. You will contribute to the continuous evolution of our cloud-based data platform, ensuring scalability, reliability and performance across our data ecosystem. Your key responsibilities include:

• Contribute to the technical implementation of complex features and services while improving architecture and reducing technical debt.

• Support other developers through code reviews, technical coaching and knowledge-sharing sessions.

• Collaborate closely with Product Architects and product teams to shape technical direction and non-functional requirements.

• Design and implement robust services, APIs and data pipelines, ensuring scalable and maintainable solutions.

• Drive best practices within code quality, testing, automation and observability.

• Evolve CI/CD pipelines and strengthen platform reliability, performance and resilience.

What will make you successful

To succeed in this role, you combine strong engineering expertise with a passion for platform development, automation and continuous improvement. You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and helping others grow through collaboration and mentoring.  We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We imagine the ideal candidate brings:

• Several years of experience developing and maintaining enterprise-scale data platforms.

• Strong expertise within Azure Databricks, Azure services, Terraform, Python/PySpark and SQL.

• Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps, GitHub and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• Understanding of architectural patterns, integration design and modern software engineering practices.

• Experience with CI/CD, test automation and DevOps methodologies.

• Knowledge of observability, performance optimization, resilience patterns and incident management.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, combined with the ability to mentor and guide colleagues.

• Professional proficiency in English.

What do we offer?

You will join a highly skilled international team working on one of Arla’s most critical technology platforms. We offer an environment where innovation, knowledge sharing and continuous learning are highly valued, and where you will have the opportunity to influence the future of our enterprise data landscape. At Arla, we are committed to professional development and empowering our people to grow their careers while making a real impact across the business.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on a continuous basis and may close the recruitment once the right candidate has been found.

For additional information, please contact Senior Manager, Thomas Morthorst Overgaard at +45 91 31 14 51.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Are you ready to lead a skilled laboratory team on an exciting change journey? Do you want to drive lager projects and digitalization to shape the laboratory of the future at one of Denmark’s largest dairies? If you are passionate about continuous improvement and want to make a real impact, keep reading to discover your next career opportunity at Esbjerg Dairy Center.

“As our new Laboratory Teamlead, you will be at the forefront of modernizing our laboratory, supporting both people and processes on our journey towards increased digitalization and automation. You’ll play a key role in taking our quality standards to the next level,” says Anne Sofie Huusmann Jepsen, Senior QEHS Manager.

How you will make an impact

As Laboratory Teamlead, you will manage and develop a larger team of lab technicians, specialists, and part-time employees at our Esbjerg Dairy Center. You’ll not only ensure the daily operations and compliance but will also lead the team through a significant transformation - embracing new digital tools and automating processes to enhance efficiency and quality.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Daily management and development of a larger laboratory team

• Drive lager projects and leading the laboratory’s change journey with a strong focus on increased digitalization and automation

• Deviation handling and release of finished goods

• Ensuring optimal and rational operation of the laboratory, including coordination of external analyses

• Collaborating with the QEHS Manager and Team to ensure quality-assured product release in accordance with regulations

• Handling and processing customer complaints in cooperation with QEHS colleagues and lab specialists

What will make you successful

We are looking for a forward-thinking professional with leadership experience and a passion for leading teams through change. Your ability to engage and inspire others will be crucial as you help bring digital transformation and automation to life.

Furthermore you bring:

• 
A track record of driving change, especially within digitalization or automation projects

• 
Ability to motivate people and foster a growth mindset

• 
Basic proficiency in Danish and English

• 
Laboratory experience, ideally including microbiology, is an advantage.

You stand out for your strong organizational skills and your ability to approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset. Your excellent interpersonal skills, combined with a proactive attitude, enable you to engage effectively with your team and drive positive change throughout the laboratory.

What do we offer?

You will join a passionate team at Esbjerg Dairy Center, where collaboration and a willingness to embrace new ways of working are key. At Arla, we are committed to professional development and promoting from within. You’ll have the opportunity to drive meaningful change and bring out the best in yourself and your colleagues, as part of a market leader producing nutritious household-favorite brands.

Would you like to join us?

If you are eager to lead a talented laboratory team through an exciting digitalization and automation journey, please apply as soon as possible, as we will process applications on a continuous basis and close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information, please contact Senior QEHS Manager Anne Sofie Huusmann Jepsen at +45 9131 9800.

jobs.occupation: Planning Expert, Site Scheduling - Centre of Excellence, Supply Chain Planning - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about production planning, site scheduling, and the systems they operate in? Do you thrive in a role where you train others in new ways of working, help improving planning processes, and you have a chance to shape the future of site scheduling? If so, this could be the right opportunity for you.

We are looking for a Planning Expert in the area of site scheduling to support our roll out programme of the new scheduling system and its associated processes, as part of a central project team.

“In Planning within Arla, we’re going through a massive transformation with introducing new planning systems and new planning processes across our production sites. You will join a highly collaborative team working closely across functions to deliver these changes to site schedulers across all core markets. If you want to play a key role in the E2E Planning transformation, we would be delighted to welcome you,” says Senior Project Manager, Mark Keresztes**.**

How you will make an impact

In this role, you will be responsible for training the site schedulers across the different sites as part of the overall roll out program. By becoming an expert in our system module of choice, SAP ePPDS, you will be able to train others in the use of the system as well the ways of working that accompany it. Your primary responsibility is to deliver this in a way that enables the site schedulers to adapt and thrive in their new system environment, so they can plan effectively, optimize within the system and therefore provide a great service within this crucial area of the supply chain.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Train site schedulers in the use of their new system

• Train site schedulers in the new ways of working and processes that accompany the new system

• Create new training materials and training approaches

• Plan the roll out activities needed as part of a central project team to deliver the above training

• Ensure the anchoring of the changes after each roll out, through support and reinforcements activities

• Collaborate with IT colleague on current and future developments to the planning system

What will make you successful

You are an energetic, structured, and collaborative professional who enjoys working with people on large scale projects. You excel in delivering your knowledge to others in an engaging and easy-to-understand manner.

We imagine you:

• Have extensive planning experience as a production planner or site scheduler

• Have extensive experience in SAP PPDS in APO

• Have a strong understanding of master data in relation to PPDS

• Have the desire and ability to train others

• Able to communicate clearly and confidently in English

• Able to produce high quality written training material in English

• Have a continuous improvement mindset and able to challenge existing ways of working

• Are curious, proactive, and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment.

What do we offer?

You’ll join a dynamic team with a strong mix of experienced professionals. We value humor, openness and support – and you’ll be trusted with responsibility from day one. At Arla, we believe in growing our people, promoting from within, and giving you the tools to succeed.

The location of the role is flexible, but ability and willingness to travel is required.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible. We process applications on a continuous basis and close the position once the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions to the position, please contact Senior Project Manager, Mark Keresztes by mail; MAKER@arlafoods.com or by phone; +45 9131 1448.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr81,720.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

**Summary

**Imagine what you could do here. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

As an Apple Channel Store Advisor, you will showcase your ambitious spirit as you take a lead role in supporting the sales, merchandising, and operations of an Apple Shop within a partner reseller store. As a dynamic leader, business manager, and influencer, you will encourage our partner’s staff through your forward-thinking style, love for technology, and passion for Apple.

Through your influence, you will grow Apple business in the multi-branded store by providing excellent customer service, conducting product demonstrations to customers, and training partner staff while ensuring all our merchandising standards are met.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

Are you our new growth hacker? Join Orifarm at the intersection of data, analytics, and business development. You will turn complex market insights into growth opportunities, strengthen portfolio decisions, improve efficiency, and help expand access to affordable medicines across Europe

About the job

As our Portfolio Intelligence & Analytics Manager you will build and maintain a structured portfolio intelligence capability that identifies, evaluates, and prioritizes external growth opportunities across European markets.

In this role, you will translate market intelligence, competitive insights, and analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for Business Development, Portfolio Management, and senior stakeholders.

Your contributions will improve the speed, quality, and consistency of portfolio decision-making, enabling Business Developers to focus on high-potential opportunities and value-creating partnerships.

Your key responsibilities:

• Own and continuously develop the portfolio intelligence capability within Business Intelligence

• Build and maintain a structured pipeline of relevant licensing and development opportunities in close collaboration with key stakeholders

• Establish analytical frameworks and scoring models for consistent opportunity assessment and prioritization

• Monitor European pharmaceutical markets, competitors, pipelines, portfolio trends, and emerging opportunities

• Provide analytical and decision support across Business Development (Rx & OTC), including opportunity assessments, business cases, and portfolio prioritization

• Apply analytics, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve the scalability and quality of the portfolio intelligence capability

• Support broader Business Intelligence activities, including dashboards, reporting, forecasting, and ad hoc analyses

This role requires on-site presence at our headquarters in Odense twice a week.

Who are you?

We are looking for a commercially minded professional with demonstrated expertise in market intelligence and a strong track record of turning complex data into actionable business insights. Experience in the pharmaceutical industry is a significant advantage, particularly within Portfolio Support, Generics, Business Development, Portfolio Management, Market Intelligence, or pharmaceutical consulting. You hold a master’s degree in Business Analytics, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Life Sciences, or a related field.

You know how to connect analytical findings with portfolio priorities and growth opportunities. You can assess markets, competitors, pipelines, strategic fit, risks, and commercial potential, then communicate your conclusions through compelling data visualizations and decision-ready presentations.

In addition, we envision that you bring:

• A can-do attitude and a team-oriented approach

• A curious, proactive mindset and a strong motivation to solve business problems through data

• Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity and turn it into clear, practical recommendations

• Fluency in English. A Nordic language is a plus

• Experience with the Power Platform is an advantage

Who are we?

As part of Business Intelligence, you will join a small, ambitious team working closely with key stakeholders across Business Development in Rx and OTC and with other relevant functions. You will work in a dynamic, international environment with a supportive, feedback-oriented culture where knowledge sharing and collaboration are part of how we succeed.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

Join Orifarm if you are curious, ambitious, and ready to accept the challenge of bringing more affordable medicine to millions of people.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our team as

**Senior Frontend Engineer – Tracking.

****Be part of the movement - and play your part.

****About The Role

**As a Senior Frontend Engineer – Tracking at DFDS, you will join a collaborative team working at the intersection of frontend engineering, customer data, analytics, and marketing technology. This is a role for someone who enjoys both hands-on implementation and seeing the bigger picture: how platforms, tracking, data flows, consent, and customer experiences connect to create better and more personalised journeys.

You will play an important part in strengthening our Martech foundation and helping us build more scalable and data-driven customer experiences across our digital platforms. The team is working on initiatives such as improving our customer data platform foundation, enabling more personalised experiences, and building reliable tracking and consent setups that allow us to work smarter across channels.

**On a Day-to-day Basis, You Will

**

• Build and improve frontend implementations that support customer-facing journeys and Martech use cases.

• Help establish and evolve a strong CDP foundation, with Twilio Segment experience considered a strong advantage.

• Work with tracking, analytics, and customer data flows to ensure reliable insights and activation across web.

This role is well suited to a senior profile who enjoys working across disciplines and who can combine implementation skills with architectural thinking.

“We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems together, can see the bigger picture across customer data and platforms, and still loves getting hands-on with implementation.”

— Noman Ahmed Khan – Frontend Chapter Lead

**About You

**We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

To succeed in this role, your experience, technical depth, and ability to connect frontend development with Martech plays key role.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Strong experience developing modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

• Extensive hands-on expertise with Google Tag Manager (GTM) and server-side GTM, including configuration, deployment, and ongoing management across different environments.

• Deep knowledge of JavaScript-based tracking implementations and data layer architecture, with experience tracking user interactions and application events.

• Experience implementing and maintaining consent management and privacy compliance solutions.

• Excellent troubleshooting skills, leveraging tools such as Chrome DevTools, Tag Assistant, network analysis, and advertising platform debugging tools.

• Experience with or a strong interest in Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), with Twilio Segment experience considered a plus.

• Proven ability to perform tracking audits, quality assurance, and debugging, identifying and resolving challenges related to event tracking, attribution, CORS, CSP, and data collection.

Working at DFDS At DFDS, you will be part of an environment where technology, collaboration, and business impact go hand in hand. This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful digital initiatives that influence how we engage with customers across channels and platforms.

• Meaningful scope: Help shape the Martech and customer data foundation behind important digital journeys.

• Modern collaboration: Work closely with colleagues across engineering, analytics and marketing.

• Growth opportunities: Develop your skills in frontend engineering, customer platforms, data flows, and personalisation.

• A collaborative culture: Join a team that values learning, shared decisions, and knowledge exchange.

• Attractive office environment: Work from our headquarters in Copenhagen, with modern facilities and a strong in-person team culture.

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, we believe that development happens first and foremost through activities in the workplace. We will also offer training courses that can support you in your role, if needed.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now. If you think your personality, skills, experience, and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

For questions regarding the technical scope or team culture, feel free to reach out to Frontend Chapter Lead, Noman Ahmed Khan at nkhan@dfds.com. Please note that we only consider applications submitted directly through our official recruitment system.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Dedicated Team Leader for Mechanical Engineering Team
jobs.description:
Polyteknik AS is expanding, and we are therefore searching for an excellent leader for our competent mechanical engineering team. The mechanical engineering team designs highly advanced production systems for the semicon/mems/sensor and ICT industries primarily in Europe.

Tasks

Our team of mechanical engineers takes Polyteknik’s advanced production systems from initial concept through detailed design to the production-ready BOM. The team currently consists of 7 people. Polyteknik has grown rapidly the recent years and continues to expand, and the mechanical engineering team will grow with it. One of your tasks as team leader will be to drive the development and expansion of the team.

You will manage the team and, in close collaboration with the process and automation engineers, physicists and skilled technicians, design and construct advanced PVD systems. The job involves coordination of a wide range of mechanical engineering tasks from idea generation to overviewing the design of complete systems involving structural, electrical, vacuum, and pneumatic components as well as ensuring the documentation and user manuals for the systems.

Other tasks

• Further development and implementation of the different Polyteknik design standards

• Resource and task planning for the team

• Ensure knowledge sharing and coordination with the other teams at Polyteknik

• Ensure that best practice is shared and efficient work methods are adapted across the team

Your profile

• Degree in Mechanical engineering or similar relevant education

• Preferably with a vast practical technical knowhow

• Proven management skills and a dialogue inviting people person

• Interest in design and vast experience with 3D construction in Solidworks

• Analytical and structured work approach and accustomed to working with deadlines

• Good at cooperating across tasks and teams, internally and externally, to achieve common goals

• Ready to obtain new knowledge about high vacuum technology, high temperature materials, and plasma processes

• Experienced communicator in Danish and English as not all team members speak Danish and most of our systems are exported and many suppliers are international

About Polyteknik AS

Polyteknik AS is a Danish PVD systems manufacturer with an innovative and best service approach. With more than 30 years in business, an international reference list, and an excellent platform of technology, Polyteknik AS has proved to be an appreciated partner in the thin film industry.

We strive to meet our customers’ needs and demands through highly qualified personnel. We strive to deliver premium products and services with uniform high quality and thus being our customers’ first choice. Our ambition is to be a reliable partner in all aspects of co-operatives.

Polyteknik AS has more than 80 dedicated and highly skilled employees and is based at our brand-new HQ in Hjallerup, a 20 minutes’ drive north of Aalborg. The job requires daily attendance at Polyteknik AS’s facility to exchange knowledge and best practice with team members and colleagues.

For more information on our company please visit our website polyteknik.com.

Research & Development

jobs.occupation: Lead Integration Developer (.NET / APIs / Cloud) for Emply
jobs.description:
**JOIN PAYCHEX EUROPE

**At Paychex Europe, we simplify payroll, HR and workforce management for businesses across Europe. We believe great results come from people who take ownership, share knowledge, challenge the status quo and treat colleagues and customers with honesty and respect. These behaviors shape our culture and reflect the values we live by: Integrity, Respect, Partnership, Curiosity, Accountability and Service.

When you join our team, you can make a mark by helping us deliver solutions that make work easier for businesses and their employees.

**Lead Integration Developer (.NET / APIs / Cloud) for Emply

**We're modernising the platform behind our rapidly growing HCM product, Emply People. As our Lead Integration Developer, you'll define the technical direction for APIs and integrations while helping evolve the platform towards a cloud-native architecture.

As a senior team member, you will be involved in hands-on coding, design, development, customization, configuration, testing, and deployment of enterprise software solutions. Additionally, you will mentor and coach colleagues while making key technical decisions, combining hands-on development with technical leadership.

Emply People is a flexible HR solution for small and medium-sized businesses, supporting the full employee journey, from recruitment and onboarding to performance, time and absence management, and offboarding.

We're transitioning to modern technologies including microservices, containerisation and serverless architectures. You'll play a key role in this transformation from an integration perspective, helping build a more scalable, efficient and agile platform.

We're looking for a Lead Developer with strong hands-on experience building enterprise-grade integrations using the .NET stack.

**What You Will Do

**Besides your daily role in Emply, you'll be part of a team of seven Lead Developers across Paychex. You'll work closely with our Architect, Product Owner/Specialist, Scrum Master, and development teams in Poland and Ukraine to design, develop, and support our browser-based product within an agile Scrum framework.

**As Lead Integration Developer, You'll Be Responsible For

**

• Defining integration architecture in collaboration with the Architect.

• Owning integration patterns and standards.

• Designing scalable APIs and integration services.

• Improving technical implementations, simplifying the codebase, and promoting coding best practices.

• Improving reliability, performance, and observability.

• Guiding the migration towards cloud-native services.

• Mentoring developers and raising engineering standards.

**What Will Help You Succeed

**We encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every single box. The following experience and skills will help you succeed in this role:

• 10+ years of proven experience designing and developing enterprise applications.

• Experience modernising legacy codebases and working with non-functional requirements such as security, performance, and scalability.

• Strong ownership of architecture and the ability to drive critical technical decisions.

• Hands-on experience with C#/.NET, MS SQL, Hangfire, REST, and GraphQL.

• Experience with API/interface modelling using OpenAPI.

• Strong understanding of integration, including enterprise integration patterns, synchronous vs. asynchronous integration, and related trade-offs.

• Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

• Experience with Git and development tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira.

• A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear business terms and act as a technical sparring partner and mentor to other developers.

• Excellent written and spoken English

**What We Offer

**In addition to Emply's incredible people and mission, we strive to foster a motivating and uplifting culture. Our offices are bright and open, with locations in Denmark and Germany. We work closely across teams and encourage a social culture, believing that working together socially makes tackling challenges more enjoyable. You will work in our Østerbro office, in a team that cares about its members and enjoys a good laugh. In short, you’ll experience plenty of learning and exciting challenges in a great work environment.

Emply is part of Paychex Europe, a leading provider of HCM solutions. Paychex Europe is growing rapidly and expanding into the European market, constantly seeking passionate talent to join them on this exciting journey. Find out more at www.emply.com.

We value different perspectives and believe diverse teams make better decisions. If this role interests you and you can see yourself contributing to our team, we encourage you to apply!

For questions about the role, please do not hesitate to contact Jacob Borella jborella@paychex.eu. Applications are reviewed continuously, and we look forward to meeting candidates who are excited about this opportunity.

Respect and partnership are at the heart of how we work together. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or background. At Paychex Europe, we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Østerbro (Hybrid)

**Full time

****PAYCHEX EUROPE

**Paychex Europe delivers Payroll, HR, and Workforce Management solutions that simplify processes, save time, and provide insights that help businesses support their people and drive success. Built on over 50 years of expertise, our solutions adapt to changing needs — helping businesses run more efficiently, today and tomorrow.

jobs.occupation: System Architect (senior specialist) - Drive the architecture of next-generation medical device plat
jobs.description:
System Architect (senior specialist) – Drive the architecture of next-generation medical device platforms

This is not a software architecture role.

At Coloplast, we develop and manufacture physical medical devices used by millions of people worldwide. As a Senior System Architect, you will help define the architectural foundations of future product families and platforms, enabling innovation, scalability, and efficient product development across generations of products.

You will shape how platforms are structured to support reuse, new technology, portfolio growth, manufacturability, and long-term business value together with other R&D disciplines.

Working at the intersection of product development, manufacturing, quality, and systems engineering, you will balance user needs, product performance, regulatory requirements, risk, and platform strategy to create robust and scalable architectural solutions. Your work will ensure that future products are built on well-defined architectural foundations that enable both innovation and efficient execution.

Join a team shaping the future of R&D

You will become part of our Requirements Engineering Team within the Centre of Excellence in R&D.

The team consists of highly skilled specialists within Requirements Engineering and Systems Architecture, working with our processes and platforms.

We support development projects across the organization and continuously strengthen how systems development is conducted in a regulated medical device environment.

Design architecture that enable innovation

As our new Senior System Architect, you will be responsible for defining and maintaining system architectures related to the products and product families for one of our Chronic Care business areas, serving as the architectural lead.

Working closely with product teams and stakeholders across R&D, you will transform business needs, user needs, stakeholder requirements, and technical opportunities into architecture decisions that balance innovation, manufacturability, regulatory compliance, risk, cost, and long-term scalability.

Specifically, you will:

• 
Define and drive the platform strategy for a dedicated business area, enabling scalable product families, reusable platform assets, and accelerated delivery of future products.

• 
Drive architectural decomposition into system capabilities, subsystems, interfaces, and architectural building blocks.

• 
Establish and maintain architecture documentation and system structures.

• 
Define system boundaries, interfaces, and allocation of functionality across the system.

• 
Identify opportunities for platform reuse, standardization, modularization, and scalability.

• 
Facilitate architectural trade-offs across business, technical, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and user perspectives.

• 
Provide architectural guidance that ensures alignment between product architecture, platform strategy, manufacturing, quality, and development activities.

• 
Support the understanding of the systems architecture discipline and the synergies to other development disciplines through close collaboration with key stakeholders across R&D and beyond

Strong architecture experience within complex product development

You combine strong systems thinking with the ability to navigate complexity and create practical solutions.

You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are comfortable influencing decisions without having formal management responsibility. You are motivated by solving real development challenges and helping teams make sound architecture decisions. You take initiative and focus on opportunities and solutions rather than constraints.

What we expect from you:

• 5+ years of experience working with Systems Architecture, Systems Engineering, or development of complex multidisciplinary products.

• Experience defining system architecture and driving technical decisions in product development programs.

• Strong understanding of systems thinking and Systems Engineering principles.

• Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines.

• You thrive both when driving tasks independently and when working closely with colleagues to achieve shared goals

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders and create alignment across functions.

• Experience from regulated industries such as medical devices, life science, aerospace, defence, industrial automation, robotics, or similar.

• Understanding of requirements engineering, risk management, verification, and validation.

• Experience with modular architectures, platform development, and reusable solutions.

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex topics to a broad stakeholder audience.

• Experience defining system boundaries, interfaces, and reusable architectural building blocks that support platform-based product development.

• Motivated by both shaping long-term architectural direction and contributing to successful day-to-day product delivery.

You might also bring

• Experience from medical device development.

• Knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, or similar standards.

• Experience with technology roadmaps and long-term architecture planning.

• Experience working with external development partners.

• Experience with architecture modelling approaches and tools.

Please note: Seniority level will be determined based on your experience (specialist or senior specialist)

Why join us?

This is a unique opportunity to influence some of Coloplast's most important development programs while helping establish platform-based development as a key capability across R&D.

You will work with highly skilled colleagues, contribute directly to products that improve people's lives, and play a vital role in enabling future innovation through strong system architecture.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Head of Requirement Engineering, Centre of Excellence, R&D, Stine Renberg at +45 49113320. We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com..

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

• Operating, troubleshooting, expanding, and designing network solutions across data center and enterprise/campus environments.

• Enhancing network security through segmentation, policy-based routing (PBR), access control, SIEM and IPS.

• Managing and optimizing Fortinet firewalls, Cisco ASR routers, ACI-switching fabric and related data center technologies.

• Automation/DevOps and Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, templates, pipelines, and code reviews.

• Collaborating closely with specialists across server, storage, and security domains while helping shape the technical direction of the network platform..

About you

You are proactive, accountable, and delivery-focused. You take accountability for your work, approach solutions with a structured and analytical mindset, help establish standards and best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of both the team and the platform. In addition, you are comfortable taking the lead and approach challenges in a structured and methodical manner.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or a related field, or possess an equivalent level of qualification.

• Have several years of experience in a similar networking role.

• Have a solid understanding of scripting, automation, and Infrastructure as Code principles.

• Have hands-on experience with firewalls and network security technologies, preferably Fortinet and/or Cisco combined with strong practical experience with enterprise routing/switching, and LAN/WAN environments.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

jobs.occupation: Would you like to build data platforms that make a difference across Europe?
jobs.description:
Shape the future of data in an international organization

Do you enjoy building scalable data platforms, designing robust data pipelines, and transforming complex business requirements into reliable data solutions?

At Daka and SARIA, we're strengthening our international data landscape and are looking for a Data Engineer who wants to play a key role in developing the data platform that supports business decisions across Europe.

Working with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Power BI, you will help build the foundation for data-driven decision-making across multiple countries, business units, and operational sites. This is an opportunity to join a growing data organization where you can influence both technical solutions and future architecture while working with modern cloud technologies.

The Role

As our new Data Engineer, you will join the international Data Solutions team and become a key contributor to the development of our next-generation data platform.

You will work across multiple systems, countries, and business areas, ensuring reliable, scalable, and high-quality data flows that support analytics, reporting, and business operations.

This role combines data engineering, architecture, and business understanding. You'll collaborate closely with eight colleagues across Europe, with one colleague based in Hedensted. The BI-team works according to Scrum principles, with stand-ups twice a week to stay aligned, share progress, and address challenges. Just as importantly, you will join a team with an open feedback culture, where colleagues actively help and challenge each other with the shared ambition of making each other better.

The position reports to Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, based in Germany.

Your primary workplace will be our headquarters in Hedensted, Denmark, where you will also be part of our local IT organization consisting of eight colleagues. While your daily home base is Denmark, your projects, stakeholders, and impact will span across Europe.

What You'll Be Working On

You will play a central role in both maintaining and further developing our data platform. Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and developing scalable data solutions in Azure Databricks

• Building, optimizing, and maintaining modern data pipelines

• Integrating data from ERP systems, operational applications, APIs, databases and cloud platforms

• Developing and maintaining semantic models in Power BI

• Ensuring data quality, reliability, and accessibility across business-critical solutions

• Supporting data architecture decisions and platform improvements

• Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Contributing to documentation, governance, and best practices across the data landscape

Your Technical Toolbox

We expect you to bring experience within several of the following areas:

• Azure Databricks

• PySpark

• SQL

• Data modelling and semantic layers

• Power BI

• APIs and system integrations

• Cloud-based data platforms

• Data architecture and platform design

• ETL/ELT development

• Data quality and governance

You don't need to tick every box, but we expect you to have strong experience within modern data engineering and a genuine interest in building scalable data solutions.

Who You Are

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You take a proactive approach, ask questions, and are comfortable challenging the status quo when you see opportunities to improve the way we work.

You enjoy taking ownership and balancing deep technical work with collaboration across different parts of the business. Working in an international environment with multiple stakeholders energizes you, and you're comfortable communicating technical topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You bring an open-minded, curious, and constructive approach to collaboration. As a senior member of the team, you are also passionate about sharing your knowledge and supporting the development of more junior colleagues.

Additionally, we imagine that you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field

• Have several years of experience working with data engineering and data platforms

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

• Take a structured and quality-oriented approach to your work

• Thrive in environments where you can influence solutions, challenge existing ways of working, and contribute to continuous improvement

Why Join Daka and SARIA?

This is not a maintenance role. You will join a business where data and digitalization are strategic priorities, and where there is a genuine ambition to strengthen the data platform across the entire organization.

In return, we offer:

• A key position in an international organization with significant growth ambitions

• Opportunity to influence architecture, tools, and future data platform development

• Modern technologies and a cloud-first data environment

• Collaboration with skilled colleagues across Denmark and Europe

• A high degree of autonomy and responsibility

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development

• Flexible working arrangements, including the option to work from home up to two days a week

• An attractive pension scheme with an 11% employer contribution

• 23 weeks of fully paid parental leave

• Lunch programme and attractive employment conditions

Beyond the professional opportunities, you'll become part of a collaborative and down-to-earth culture where people genuinely enjoy working together. From social events and staff association activities to an informal coffee break with colleagues, community is an important part of everyday life at our headquarters in Hedensted.

Interested in joining us?

We look forward to hearing from you. Please submit your CV with a motivated profile summary through the "Apply" link.

The recruitment process consists of two interviews at our headquarters in Hedensted, with Mirco joining online. The first interview focuses on your experience, motivation, and technical skills. The second includes feedback on a personality profile and cognitive assessment.

Due to scheduled holidays, we will begin conducting interviews in November. We look forward to getting to know you then.

If you have questions regarding the role, please contact Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, phone: +49 151 729 33 576.

If you have questions about the Danish team or daily work life, please contact Thorbjørn Kloster, Head of CIO Office, phone: +45 2947 1215.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As Lead IT Auditor at SimCorp, you will be responsible for leading and executing IT audits to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, information security systems, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. This role involves assessing IT infrastructure, systems, and processes to identify vulnerabilities and areas for improvement. The Lead / Principal IT Auditor works closely with business units and senior leadership to test whether IT risks are managed effectively, and that the organization’s technology systems support its compliance and operational objectives.

In an IT organization like SimCorp, the Lead / Principal IT Auditor promotes collaboration among business, information security, risk management, and Internal Audit. By conducting risk-based audits and identifying relevant issues, the auditor enhances IT governance, risk management, and business resilience, ensuring compliance with policies and industry standards while promoting continuous improvement and accountability

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead and execute IT audits across various business units to assess the effectiveness of internal controls and the security of IT systems and infrastructure

• Evaluate IT processes, applications, and systems for compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards, and industry best practices

• Identify and assess IT risks, vulnerabilities, and control gaps, providing actionable recommendations for mitigation and improvement

• Collaborate with IT teams and business units to ensure that audit findings are addressed and corrective actions are implemented effectively

• Prepare detailed audit reports documenting findings, recommendations, and action plans, and present these reports to senior leadership

• Monitor and track the implementation of corrective actions from prior audits to assess improvements implemented by the business and issues are resolved in a timely manner

• Ensure that audits are conducted in alignment with industry standards and regulatory requirements concerning audit of IT-related risks

• Assist in developing audit plans, schedules, and priorities, ensuring audits are conducted in line with organizational objectives

• Assist in developing and refining audit methodologies, tools, and processes to improve IT audit practices

• Stay current on emerging IT risks, regulatory changes, and audit standards to ensure that audit practices remain effective and relevant

• Provide guidance and support to junior auditors, supporting their development in IT auditing and auditing standards

**TYPE OF WORK THIS ROLE ENAGES WITH

**

• Leading IT audits to evaluate IT infrastructure, security, and compliance

• Identifying vulnerabilities and recommending improvements to strengthen IT controls and mitigate risks

• Collaborating with business and IT teams to address audit findings and validate the implemented corrective actions

**What We Value

**

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Security or similar relevant field

• 7+ years of professional experience of practical IT auditing

• Strong cross-domain IT knowledge, including network technology, operating systems, Information Security, SDLC, cloud (MS Azure)

• Solid knowledge of common IT and security standards such as CSA-CCM, ITIL, COBIT, BSI IT Grundschutz, NIST, CIS-18 and ISO/IEC 27000 series

• Relevant professional certification such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or CIA preferred

• High analytical skills, methodical know-how and conceptual understanding of complex matters

• Fluent English and effective interpersonal communication abilities

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please click the “Apply” button to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Please note only applications sent through our system will be processed. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is a good match, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

By Joining our team, you will have the chance to become part of a thriving company comprising collaborative, curious, courageous, and capable employees Explore a multitude of exciting learning and development opportunities, supported by our unique learning guild Engage with highly skilled and supportive colleagues, each bringing their diverse backgrounds and perspectives Join a company that not only values but actively advocates for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, cultivating a truly inclusive and empowering environment.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.
